༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ba)pa'i dkar chag/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun mkhyen rig pa 'dzin pa chen po chos kyi grags pa'i gsung 'bum (ba)pa'i dkar chag /

ka legs par sbyar ba'i skad kyis brda sprod pa ka lā pa'i mtshams sbyor gyi rgyas 'grel mu tig gi phreng ba/ 1 kha sngags kyi klog tshul dang yi ge'i khams kyi sdeb sbyor mdor bsdus don gsal phrin las kun 'grub/73 ga shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snying po nyi shu lnga pa skad gnyis shan sbyar ba/89 nga snyan ngag me long gi rgyan gyi dper brjod gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam ngag gi 'dod 'jo*/97 ca rje btsun bzhad pa rdo rjer snyan ngag gi bstod pa ka la piṅka gsal bar byas pa/157 cha rin chen grang sbyor ril nag gi sngon byung gleng gzhi/169 ja rin chen ril nag chen mo'i zin bris brtan g.yo'i bcud bsdus mkhas pa dga' byed/175 nya rin chen grang sbyor ril nag gi kha skong ldum sman gyi man ngag/191 ta rin chen ril bu 'thag thabs kyi zhal gdams/193 tha kong bu 'dag sbyor zhal gdams/195 da ril nag 'bring po dang chung ngu'i zin bris 'chi ba gshol 'debs/197 na grang sbyor ril nag drang nges brtag pa mu tig gi phreng*/201 pa grang sbyor ril nag gi phan yon mos ldan dga' ba'i dbyar rnga/203 pha rin chen ril bu gtong tshul gyi zin bris/209 ba rin chen ril bu'i cha lag sbyar dug gso thabs/217 ma rin chen grangs sbyor ril bu'i cha lag phran bu'i dug gso thabs/231 tsa rin chen tsha sbyor gyi zin bris gcong nad bde ster/235 tsha rin chen ril nag che 'bring chung ngu'i sbas don gsal byed nam mkha'i nor bu*/239 dza nyer lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'i sbyor ba rin chen srog gi rgyab rten/245 wa 'bam bcos tshe 'dzin srog skyob/259 zha rims bcos gud du bkol ba rin chen srog gi zhags pa/273
